rules.name: passive-observation-stays-open
rules.reason: Passive queries against public datasets do not touch a target.

rules.name: no-active-probing-by-default
rules.reason: Direct contact with a target is off until an allow rule names the tool and target.

rules.name: no-destructive-without-a-rule
rules.reason: Destructive work is off until an allow rule names the tool and target.
